CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, May 17, 2023, 2023 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Maria Jimenez, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR 2023-2024 TERM
  Election of President
  Election of Vice-President

 IV.  APPROVAL OF THE APRIL 19, 2023 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

  V.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
  Unofficial until adopted by the  May 17, 2023
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item IV
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, April 19, 2023
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:04 P.M. on Wednesday, April 19, 2023, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, and Commission Member Massaro.
Committee Members Absent: Commission Member Jimenez
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE MARCH 15, 2023 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the minutes from the March 15, 2023 regular meeting were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
President Canseco will return to the next meeting with kinetic wind structure estimates
renderings. Vice President Saunders, Commission Member Hermano, and Commission Member
Massaro are still exploring concepts and locations.

STAFF REPORT
Director Macias presented three renderings of Alhambra’s possible 2024 Tournament of Roses
Parade Float design and the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission collectively agreed to
move forward with the rendering titled “Dragon Music” as it would be best appropriate for the
2024 Chinese New Year of the Dragon. The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission
recommended revisions to the rendering that included an addition of clouds, instruments, musical
elements, and a larger Earth. Director Macias will bring a revised rendering in May for a Special
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

Recreation Supervisor Leonard invited the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and their
families to attend Arbor Day and Eco Fair.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
 President Canseco reminded Commission members to complete their ethics training sent by City
Clerk.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Hermano and seconded by Vice President Saunders, the
April 19, 2023 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:40 P.M.
